fact: The Namibian reports a N$40m contract awarded in June 2026 to 6th Grain Corporation to deploy an AI and satellite-imagery crop-monitoring system for the agriculture ministry, which the government terminated in August 2026 as not meeting legal and procedural requirements.
system: AI and satellite imagery-driven crop monitoring system

fact: The agriculture ministry signed a one-year N$39.5 million contract with 6th Grain Corporation to introduce satellite imagery and AI to monitor staple crops, forecast crops and assess drought (Windhoek Observer, citing the ministry and US Embassy).
Through the Science Granting Councils Initiative the NCRST has funded projects on AI-powered tools for early disease detection, per the NCRST authors citing SGCI 2024.
